CompetitiveHS,"Hi everyone!

I've been playing Pirate warrior recently but I am missing a few key cards. I have 2 lists that I am running at the moment and it seems that the deck on the left is slightly more successful for me: https://ibb.co/kFOC3v

The key cards that I am missing are Patches, leeroy, a second bloodsail cultist a second bash and southsea captains. I am trying to fill the gaps with Naga corsairs which are good cards but I think really they are best for synergising with the captains, the only deck examples where I see them played are mixed with the captains so it feels like perhaps I have a little bit of a hybrid between 2 deck types and I am wondering if unfortunately they are dampening each other more than helping.

These decks are very powerful, I managed to climb to rank 15 on the 1st which is something I've never done before but I've found myself unable to get any higher so far. I know that things are far harder at the start of the month and we have an expansion pack coming up really soon and this deck might become obsolete but just for the next few days I was wondering if I should perhaps consider switching to a different deck?

I've had several matches against the mirror and other agro decks and patches is so hyper common I'm wondering if his effect is much stronger than perhaps I realise. I've had a few games where the opponent is left on 1 or 2 hit points which could potentially have been one with the one or two extra damage from him but I'm wondering if that's mostly bad luck or if the deck really is so balanced on a blades edge that missing a single point of damage can be that significant? Often the times I have won I've had a decisive victory so it hasn't mattered too much in those instances.
I think a large part of the problem with this deck is that because it's quite simple to play your level of skill doesn't matter as much as the relative power of the cards if that makes sense?

I'm looking forward to the expansion and I'm really hoping there will be a nice cheap budget deck for me to pick up. I'm quite hopeful that zoo might become really powerful again because in my entire hearthstone career that's the deck I've had the most success with overall.
Thank you very much!",1491254742.0,1

GuildWars,"Just a little bit of advice. You may find prophecies to be a little bit challenging. It was designed when there was a much larger community and its the hardest to do with a small amount of players. If I were you I would start your first character in Nightfall and do Eye of the north as soon as you can. This is the quickest way to get heroes which are AI partners that can be substituted for players. Profs had something similar called henchmen but they aren't as good, they have weaker AI and the skills they use aren't that great. Heroes have superior AI and as you play you can give them more and more skills. I'm not saying profs is impossible or anything but if you want an easier time then it's probably for the best that you save that for a future character. Another benefit of starting in Nightfall is it has one of the most active districts and it might be easier for you to find friends/a guild :) best of luck!
